newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips decline, SAX index dips further.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips decline, SAX index dips further.

text.p: Major Slovak shares eased in listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, as the SAX index continued its downtrend.

Slovnaft edged down by 10 crowns on Wednesday, closing at 690, helping push the SAX down 0.71 points to 166.86 points. Brokers said they expected little in the market's bearish sentiment in the near future.
"The general decline continues, causing losses to almost all blue chips at the moment. The fall of Slovnaft issue is probably the best example of this," said Dusan Sykora of ING Barings.
"I am afraid Slovnaft might plunge through the 600 crown level soon and continue to fall even lower," he added.
Steel maker VSZ dropped 30 crowns to 485, while oil and gas storage company Nafta eased 40 crowns, to 1,300.
Overall volume fell to 64,853 shares, from 861,330 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover decreased to 42.744 million crowns, from 527.85 million.
